{{Quote|I really can't say much. The story develops the relationship between Nomi and Vima Sunrider and involves a resurgent threat from Sith and Mandalorian forces. Plus I introduce a new character that I'm really enjoying, a sort of interstellar scavenger who runs across some artifacts that are a little more than he can handle.|Alex Irvine|<ref name="SFSignal">{{WebCite|url=http://www.sfsignal.com/archives/2009/09/interview-alex-irvine|text=INTERVIEW: Alex Irvine|work=[https://www.sfsignal.com SF Signal]|archivedate=20091004101540}}</ref>}}
Tentatively titled '''''Mandorla''''',<ref name="EUCantina">{{WebCite|url=http://www.eucantina.net/archives/8408|text=Irvine Clarifies Mandorla Title Statement|work=[http://www.eucantina.net EUCantina.net]|archivedate=20100909172904}}</ref> this novel by [[Alex Irvine]] was to be set in the time of the ancient [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]],<ref name="DR2013">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20090919.html|text=The Publishing Horizon: The Next Three Years}}</ref> and would have featured [[Nomi Sunrider]].<ref name="SueBlog">{{Blog|eeusuestornii|11|A bit about the new novels.....}}</ref> It was to be "set just before the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic]]'' storyline."<ref name="Blogspot">{{Blogspot|subdomain=alexirvine|url=2008/09/star-wars.html|name=[[Alex Irvine]]|text=Star Wars!}}</ref> It was confirmed as canceled on February 29, 2012.<ref name="Cancelled">{{Facebook|username=starwarsbooks|url=starwarsbooks/posts/10150654342868713|name=Star Wars Books|date=2012-02-29|archivedate=20200525012235}}</ref>
